text: Look at the picture marked number one in your test book. (A) The woman is sitting at a picnic table. (B) The woman is reading a newspaper. (C) The woman is loading a truck. (D) The woman is walking along a path.
Look at the picture marked number two in your test book. (A) Some crates are stacked on a pallet. (B) A worker is driving a forklift. (C) The shelves have been emptied. (D) A door is being repaired.

Questions three through five refer to the following announcement. Attention, all tenants. Please be aware that maintenance work on the lobby entrance will begin this Wednesday and continue through the end of the week. During this time the main doors will be closed, and we ask that you use the side entrance on Le Loi Street instead. Deliveries will also be redirected there. We expect the work to finish by Friday evening, and the main entrance will reopen on Monday morning. Thank you for your patience.
